description: Render a small, safe subset of markdown to HTML: headings (# to ###), bold, italic, links (http, https or mailto only), inline code, fenced code blocks, bulleted and numbered lists, and blockquotes. Every character is HTML-escaped first, so raw HTML is shown as text and never executed. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/markdown-previewer/
name: hopi_markdown_previewer
